name: Inclusif Widget
author: inclusiflife

sections.description:
Inclusif Widget is a plugin that integrates Inclusif accessibility tools into your WordPress website. It provides an accessibility widget that helps users with disabilities navigate and use your website more effectively.

Main features:

  • Customizable accessibility widget – Toolbar that appears on your website
  • Multiple positions – Configure where the widget appears (screen corners)
  • Multilanguage support – Available in Spanish and English
  • Easy configuration – Intuitive administration panel in WordPress
  • Secure API Key – Authentication through API key

What does the accessibility widget do?

The Inclusif widget provides tools that allow users to:
* Adjust contrast and text size
* Navigate by keyboard more easily
* Use screen readers in an optimized way
* Customize the visual experience according to their needs

Requirements:

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A valid Inclusif API Key (get it from the Inclusif panel)

This plugin is ideal for websites that seek to improve their accessibility.

Support and Documentation

For technical support, additional documentation or to report issues:

  • Visit the official Inclusif documentation
  • Contact the Inclusif support team
  • Check that your API Key and domain are correctly configured

Privacy

This plugin connects to Inclusif services to validate the API Key and load the accessibility widget. The processed data includes:
* The API Key for authentication
* The website domain for validation
* Widget configurations (position, language)

Personal data from end users is not collected without their explicit consent.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation:

  1. Go to your WordPress administration panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Inclusif”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Configuration:

  1. Once activated, go to Inclusif in the administration menu
  2. Enter your Inclusif API Key (required)
  3. Configure the widget options:
    • Activate tools: Enable/disable the widget
    • Position: Select where it will appear (bottom-right, bottom-left, etc.)
    • Language: Choose Spanish or English
  4. Save the configuration

Getting an API Key:

  • Visit the Inclusif panel to generate your API Key
  • The API Key is necessary for the widget to work correctly
  • Each API Key is associated with specific domains for greater security
sections.faq:
Do I need an API Key to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a valid Inclusif API Key for the accessibility widget to work. You can get an API Key by registering in the Inclusif panel.

Is the plugin free?

The WordPress plugin is free, but you need an Inclusif account to get the API Key. Check the available plans on the Inclusif website.

What WordPress versions are compatible?

This plugin requires WordPress 6.7 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher.

Can I customize the widget’s appearance?

Yes, you can configure the widget’s position (screen corners) and language through the administration panel. The widget design itself is optimized for accessibility.

Does the widget affect my site’s speed?

The widget is optimized to load efficiently and should not significantly affect your website’s performance.

Does it work with all WordPress themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme that follows development best practices.

Can I use the plugin on multiple sites?

It depends on your Inclusif plan and the domain configuration in your API Key. Each domain must be authorized to use the API Key.

What if my API Key doesn’t work?

Verify that:
– The API Key is correctly copied (without additional spaces)
– Your domain is authorized to use that API Key
– Your Inclusif account is active

Does the plugin comply with WCAG?

Yes, Inclusif tools are compatible with WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines).
